name: Almanara Electric Trd Co شركة المنارة الكهربائية للتجارة
note: Gate 2/3 fail confirmed: sole KSA distributor/retailer of electrical switches, sockets, panel boards and lighting/chandeliers (also runs a panel-board factory). Electrical fittings for construction is a hard-fail category and lighting-only is a narrow low-repeat fail; a live e-commerce site does not rescue a hard-fail category.

name: Almutahidah
note: Gate 2 fail confirmed via search: a domestic-services/HR company (hourly home cleaning, trained domestic workers/maids, drivers, cooking, laundry), not product retail of any kind.

name: Aramco Lubricants & Retail Company
note: Gate 2 fail: a Saudi Aramco lubricants/fuel subsidiary under the parent corporate site with no dedicated consumer storefront; petroleum/lubricant/fuel retail is not an approved category.

name: Cadillac Aljomaih
note: Gate 2 fail: official Cadillac/GM automotive dealer-distributor in Saudi Arabia, an explicit hard-fail category regardless of scale.

name: CVD Zahid Tractor
note: Gate 2 fail: Commercial Vehicles Division of Zahid Tractor, exclusive Saudi distributor of Volvo/UD/Renault trucks and buses; automotive/heavy-industrial distribution is an explicit hard-fail category.

name: Decorella Panits EST
note: Gate 2/3/4 fail confirmed: a Riyadh paint retail shop (Zaid Abdul Rahman Al Shalhoub Trading Est); paint is a construction-material-adjacent narrow low-repeat line, and no live e-commerce exists (only directory listings and a phone number).

name: GRAND HYPER MARKET
note: Gate 1 geography fail confirmed: Grand Hyper/Regency Group (Grand Corporate) is HQ'd in Dubai, UAE (Al Quoz 4); the Qatar outlets are a local branch of a UAE-HQ'd network, so it fails even though the Qatar operation is real and live.

name: Jazirat Samaa Fashion
note: Gate 4 fail: a genuine small Al Ahsa apparel chain (category/geography pass), but English, Arabic and app-store searches found no live transactional store or consumer app, only directory/LinkedIn listings; Gate 7 defaults such unconfirmable digital presence to OUT.

name: Juffali Automotive Company
note: Gate 2 fail: JACO is the official Mercedes-Benz distributor in Saudi Arabia; automotive dealer/distributor is an explicit hard-fail category despite the genuine Saudi HQ.

name: Kia Aljabr I كيا الجبر
note: Gate 2 fail: Aljabr holds the exclusive Kia distributorship for part of the Kingdom (28 showrooms); automotive dealer/distributor is a hard-fail category despite the Saudi HQ.

name: Kia NMC - الشركة الأهلية للتسويق
note: Gate 2 fail: National Marketing Company is the official Kia distributor for the remaining Saudi regions; automotive dealer/distributor is a hard-fail category.

name: Kuwait Automotive Imports Company(Al Shaya & Al Sagar)
note: Gate 2 fail: KAICO is a Kuwait-HQ'd exclusive distributor for Mazda, Peugeot, Geely and IVECO; automotive distribution is a hard-fail category despite the genuine Kuwait HQ.

name: Landmark Arabia
note: Gate 1 geography fail: Landmark Arabia is the Saudi division of Landmark Group, genuinely HQ'd in Dubai, UAE; a UAE-HQ'd operator fails geography even with 650+ real stores in KSA (same logic the ICP applies to Nesto/Spinneys).

name: LubeExSA
note: Gate 2/3 fail: a mobile lubricant/tire-changing service that refers tire orders to TireEx; automotive lubricants/tires services are a hard-fail category and a narrow single-line offering, with no own e-commerce.

name: Lubnaas Boutique
note: Gate 4 fail confirmed: lubnaas.com does not serve a working store (independent fetch returned 503, consistent with the reported unbound Netlify cert); this single-designer Doha boutique operates via Facebook/phone/in-store with no cart, checkout, alternate domain or app.

name: Mercedes-Benz KSA
note: Gate 2 fail: the KSA storefront is operated by Juffali Automotive Company (Saudi-HQ'd); automotive dealer is a hard-fail category.

name: Mercedes-Benz Kuwait - Al Mulla Automobiles Co.
note: Gate 2 fail: operated by Al Mulla Automobiles (Kuwait-HQ'd Mercedes-Benz distributor); automotive dealer is a hard-fail category.

name: Mercedes-Benz Qatar
note: Gate 2 fail: operated by Nasser Bin Khaled Automobiles (Doha/Qatar-HQ'd Mercedes-Benz distributor); automotive dealer is a hard-fail category.

name: Mobil Oil
note: Gate 2 fail: Mobil lubricants/fuels in KSA are distributed by APSCO via wholesale/B2B petroleum, lubricant, aviation-fuel and marine-bunker distribution, a non-retail hard-fail category with no consumer retail arm.

name: MODERN METAL INDUSTRIES COMPANY
note: Gate 2 fail: MMICO manufactures cable trays, steel lintels, cladding fixation and gypsum profiles for construction; building-materials manufacturing/construction B2B is a hard-fail category.

name: Nabina Group مجموعة نابينا
note: Gate 2/6 fail confirmed: a Qatar conglomerate dominated by building materials, marble/kitchen-and-door factories (project/install model), contracting, real-estate brokerage and auto service; no substantial dedicated consumer retail arm with a digital channel (the Loafie cafe is incidental), so the mixed parent is excluded.

name: NBK FASHION
note: Gate 4 fail confirmed: NBK Fashion (Quiksilver/Roxy/DC distributor, Qatar) has no own transactional site (nbkfashion.net DNS-fails) and no own app; the brands sell online in Qatar only via third-party marketplaces (Noon/Next/VogaCloset), its own presence being Instagram plus physical mall stores.

name: Nesto Hypermarket Kuwait
note: Gate 1 geography fail: Nesto Group (Western International Group) is HQ'd in the UAE (Jebel Ali, Dubai), and Nesto is explicitly named in the ICP as a UAE-HQ geography fail; the 20+ Kuwait outlets do not change the call.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch Co.
note: Exclusion holds though the 'dead site' reason is weak: A&F does sell online in KSA, but the Saudi operating entity is Majid Al Futtaim (Dubai/UAE-HQ'd) and A&F Co. itself is US-HQ'd, so it fails Gate 1 geography and is a Gate 6 consolidation case rather than a standalone Saudi retailer.
